messages:
Asha (sales): Cygnus POC kickoff. Customer wants a reproducible perf run + cost options. Targets: p95 <= 220ms, p99 <= 400ms at steady 25 qps, with 3x 45s microbursts to 100 qps. Workload = mixed prompts (40% short ~32t, 40% mid ~128t, 20% long ~384t). KV cache expected to be enabled with ~55% prefix hit. Need a run plan, infra spec, and hosted vs reserved pricing by EOD Monday. cc @Priya @Ben

Ben (SE): Copy. A few quick clarifying q's: single region (us-west2) ok? Which model? Recommend redwood-v1-xl (fp16) for fidelity; offer redwood-v1-xl-int8 as cost option. Also: do they want cold-starts included?

Asha (sales): Single-region us-west2. Customer said cold-starts not critical for the benchmark, focus on steady-state and burst recovery.

Ben (SE): Proposed run plan:
- Pre-warm: 3m at 8 qps
- Ramp: linear 8 -> 25 qps over 4m
- Steady: 25 qps for 20m (collect p50/p90/p95/p99 + seqlen buckets)
- Bursts: 3x 45s at 100 qps spaced 90s apart
- Prompt mix: 40/40/20 short/med/long; token accounting included
- Cache: KV prefix cache enabled, simulate 55% hit by sampling prefix set
- Repeats: run float16 baseline then int8 quant for comparison

Ben (SE): Quick k6 example for reproducibility:
```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { check } from 'k6';
export default function() {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({model: 'redwood-v1-xl', prompt: '...'});
  const res = http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', payload, {headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer $TOKEN'}});
  check(res, { 'status 200': (r) => r.status == 200 });
}
```

Ravi (infra): For this mix I'd suggest a dedicated test pool: 3 x A100-40G-equivalent nodes (or 2x if we spike). Concurrency tuning: per-GPU inflight requests cap ~48; batch size 1 for latency. For long prompts, memory pressure can be high; we'll instrument by max_seq bucket.

Ben (SE): Measurement plan: tag each request with seqlen bucket and cache-hit boolean, aggregate histograms. We'll compute cost-per-request by tokens and infra amortization. Also export tail-latency heatmap.

Asha (sales): Customer wants hosted vs reserved pricing examples. Ben can you provide: hosted estimate, dedicated reserved monthly amortized (3-node example), and delta if they use int8 quant.

Ben (SE): Back-of-envelope estimates (will refine with real token counts):
- Hosted: ~$0.52 / 1k tokens (xl, fp16) -> approx $Y for daily steady 25 qps mix
- Dedicated reserved (3 nodes): ~45-55% of hosted cost at >=60% utilization depending on amortization window
- int8: ~30-40% CPU/GPU cost reduction but expect +12-20ms on p95 for long prompts
I'll run precise calc after we get token histogram from the sample corpus.

Asha (sales): Security Q incoming: they asked about KMS, audit logs, and VPC peering. We'll send the questionnaire but want a short answer here: can we support customer-managed keys & VPC for dedicated?

security-bot: Security summary: Dedicated/Private supports customer KMS, HSM integrations via our KMS bridge; VPC peering supported for Private. Audit logs retained 90d by default; longer retention available as enterprise add-on. Compliance posture: SOC2 controls in place; we can provide attestation PDFs under NDA.

Ravi (infra): ops-bot: provisioned test pool "cygnus-poc-usw2-01" (3 nodes) for 2h on 2025-02-10T20:00:00Z. Canary image includes latest kernel; note we should run a kernel-canary first to measure long prompt p99 delta.

Ben (SE): I'll prepare two runbooks (fp16 / int8), k6 artifacts, and a spreadsheet with the cost model. Deliverables by Mon EOD: run results, CSV histograms, cost calc, and recommendation.

Priya (AE): Customer confirmed Mon 20:00 UTC. They'll upload a 1k-sample corpus for token profiling by Fri EOD. Also asked if we can include a short video walkthrough of the run results.

Asha (sales): Great. Ben, include regional failover notes (how latency changes if multi-region needed) and a short paragraph on recommended SLA tier if they need tighter guarantees.

Ben (SE): Will do. One more note: if we enable aggressive KV caching (higher than 55%), cost can drop but synthetic burst behavior may change; will include sensitivity analysis.

Asha (sales): Thanks all. :rocket:

Priya (AE): :thumbsup:
